creators.name: Susan Amkraut
creators.role: Computer animator and virtual-environment artist
creators.bio: Computer animation pioneer who, with Michael Girard, built behavioural animation systems for flocks and walking creatures in the late 1980s and early 1990s.
creators.why: Menagerie was one of the first head-mounted VR worlds filled with autonomous animals instead of objects.
creators.role_zh: 计算机动画师与虚拟环境艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 计算机动画先驱，1980 年代末至 1990 年代初与 Michael Girard 一起开发了鸟群与行走生物的行为动画系统。
creators.why_zh: 《Menagerie》是最早一批以自主动物而不是物体填满的头戴式 VR 世界之一。

creators.name: Michael Girard
creators.role: Computer animator, co-creator of Menagerie
creators.bio: Animator and researcher known for procedural legged-locomotion animation; co-founded Unreal Pictures with Susan Amkraut.
creators.why: His locomotion systems gave the virtual animals of Menagerie believable bodies.
creators.role_zh: 计算机动画师，《Menagerie》联合创作者
creators.bio_zh: 以程序化多足行走动画闻名的动画师与研究者，与 Susan Amkraut 共同创办 Unreal Pictures。
creators.why_zh: 他的运动系统让《Menagerie》里的虚拟动物有了可信的身体。

creators.name: Scott Fisher
creators.role: VR pioneer, NASA Ames VIEW lab and Telepresence Research
creators.bio: Led the NASA Ames Virtual Interface Environment Workstation in the 1980s and later founded Telepresence Research and the USC Mobile and Environmental Media Lab.
creators.why: He produced and documented Menagerie, linking early VR engineering to artists working with animals.
creators.role_zh: VR 先驱，NASA Ames VIEW 实验室与 Telepresence Research
creators.bio_zh: 1980 年代领导 NASA Ames 的虚拟界面环境工作站，后创办 Telepresence Research 与南加州大学移动与环境媒体实验室。
creators.why_zh: 他制作并记录了《Menagerie》，把早期 VR 工程与关注动物的艺术家连接起来。

creators.name: Rebecca Allen
creators.role: Media artist and professor, UCLA Design Media Arts
creators.bio: Pioneer of computer animation and artificial-life art since the 1970s; founding chair of UCLA Design Media Arts.
creators.why: The Bush Soul series treated a virtual world as the wild place where a person's animal soul lives.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家，加州大学洛杉矶分校设计媒体艺术系教授
creators.bio_zh: 1970 年代起的计算机动画与人工生命艺术先驱，加州大学洛杉矶分校设计媒体艺术系创系主任。
creators.why_zh: 《The Bush Soul》系列把虚拟世界当作一个人的动物灵魂栖居的荒野。

creators.name: Ars Electronica Futurelab
creators.role: Art and technology research lab of Ars Electronica
creators.bio: In-house R&D lab of the Ars Electronica Center, founded in 1996, building immersive, robotic and public-space installations.
creators.why: Its Humphrey flight simulators were among the first public installations to let visitors fly with their whole body.
creators.role_zh: Ars Electronica 的艺术与技术研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: Ars Electronica Center 的研发实验室，1996 年成立，制作沉浸式、机器人与公共空间装置。
creators.why_zh: 它的 Humphrey 飞行模拟器是最早让公众用全身飞行的装置之一。

creators.name: Hiroo Iwata
creators.role: Professor of VR and haptics, University of Tsukuba
creators.bio: Haptics and locomotion-interface researcher and media artist, known for Floating Eye, the Torus Treadmill and Big Robot.
creators.why: Floating Eye detached vision from the body and handed it to a flying machine.
creators.role_zh: 筑波大学 VR 与触觉教授
creators.bio_zh: 触觉与行走界面研究者和媒体艺术家，代表作包括《Floating Eye》、Torus Treadmill 与 Big Robot。
creators.why_zh: 《Floating Eye》把视觉从身体上拆下来，交给一台飞行的机器。

creators.name: Kazuhiko Hachiya
creators.role: Media artist
creators.bio: Japanese media artist whose devices rewire communication and the body, from the Inter Discommunication Machine to the PostPet mail software and the OpenSky jet glider.
creators.why: He built both a winged headset for swapping perspectives and a real one-person aircraft modelled on a fictional bird-glider.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 日本媒体艺术家，作品改写交流方式与身体，从《Inter Discommunication Machine》到 PostPet 邮件软件和 OpenSky 喷气滑翔机。
creators.why_zh: 他既做了交换视角的带翼头戴装置，也造了一架以虚构“鸟形滑翔机”为原型的单人飞机。

creators.name: Myron Krueger
creators.role: Computer artist, pioneer of 'artificial reality'
creators.bio: Built responsive environments from 1969 onward (Glowflow, Metaplay, Psychic Space) and coined 'artificial reality'.
creators.why: Videoplace showed that a body could inhabit a graphic world without goggles or gloves.
creators.role_zh: 计算机艺术家，“人工现实”先驱
creators.bio_zh: 1969 年起创作响应式环境（Glowflow、Metaplay、Psychic Space），并提出“人工现实”一词。
creators.why_zh: 《Videoplace》证明身体可以不戴眼镜和手套就进入一个图形世界。

creators.name: Christa Sommerer
creators.role: Media artist and professor, Kunstuniversität Linz
creators.bio: Trained in botany and sculpture; with Laurent Mignonneau she has made interactive artificial-life installations since 1992.
creators.why: Her works with Mignonneau made real plants and growing virtual plants into interfaces for the human body.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家，林茨艺术大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 学过植物学与雕塑，自 1992 年起与 Laurent Mignonneau 合作创作交互式人工生命装置。
creators.why_zh: 她与 Mignonneau 的作品把真实植物和生长的虚拟植物变成人体的界面。

creators.name: Laurent Mignonneau
creators.role: Media artist and professor, Kunstuniversität Linz
creators.bio: French artist and engineer who co-creates interactive artificial-life works with Christa Sommerer, including A-Volve and Interactive Plant Growing.
creators.why: He built the plant-sensing and growth systems behind their early botanical interfaces.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家，林茨艺术大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家与工程师，与 Christa Sommerer 共同创作《A-Volve》《Interactive Plant Growing》等交互式人工生命作品。
creators.why_zh: 他搭建了两人早期植物界面背后的植物感应与生长系统。

creators.name: Knowbotic Research
creators.role: Media art group (Yvonne Wilhelm, Christian Hübler, Alexander Tuchacek)
creators.bio: Artist group founded in 1991 that builds interfaces to data networks and remote environments.
creators.why: Dialogue with the Knowbotic South turned Antarctica's data streams into a place a visitor could sense and move through.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术小组（Yvonne Wilhelm、Christian Hübler、Alexander Tuchacek）
creators.bio_zh: 1991 年成立的艺术小组，为数据网络和远方环境制作界面。
creators.why_zh: 《Dialogue with the Knowbotic South》把南极的数据流变成观众可以感知和穿行的地方。

creators.name: Beatriz da Costa
creators.role: Artist and researcher, UC Irvine (1974–2012)
creators.bio: Tactical-media artist working across biology, activism and engineering; co-founder of Critical Art Ensemble-adjacent projects and author of Tactical Biopolitics.
creators.why: PigeonBlog made pigeons into airborne co-researchers whose flights produced a pollution map.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与研究者，加州大学欧文分校（1974–2012）
creators.bio_zh: 横跨生物学、行动主义与工程的战术媒体艺术家，《Tactical Biopolitics》编者。
creators.why_zh: 《PigeonBlog》让鸽子成为空中的共同研究者，用飞行绘出污染地图。

creators.name: Natalie Jeremijenko
creators.role: Artist and engineer, Environmental Health Clinic, NYU
creators.bio: Artist-engineer whose Environmental Health Clinic prescribes actions with other species; works include Feral Robotic Dogs, OOZ and Tree Logic.
creators.why: She designs interfaces through which people and fish, birds or trees can signal to each other.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与工程师，纽约大学环境健康诊所
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家兼工程师，她的环境健康诊所为人与其他物种的共处开出“处方”；作品包括 Feral Robotic Dogs、OOZ 与 Tree Logic。
creators.why_zh: 她设计让人与鱼、鸟或树互相传递信号的界面。

creators.name: The Living
creators.role: Architecture studio (David Benjamin, Soo-in Yang)
creators.bio: New York architecture studio founded by David Benjamin and Soo-in Yang, working with living materials and environmental sensing.
creators.why: Amphibious Architecture made fish presence in a city river visible and textable.
creators.role_zh: 建筑工作室（David Benjamin、Soo-in Yang）
creators.bio_zh: 由 David Benjamin 与 Soo-in Yang 创办的纽约建筑工作室，关注活体材料与环境感知。
creators.why_zh: 《Amphibious Architecture》让城市河流中鱼的存在变得可见，还能通过短信回应。

creators.name: Don Allison
creators.role: VR researcher, GVU Center, Georgia Tech
creators.bio: Georgia Tech graduate researcher who led the Virtual Reality Gorilla Exhibit with Larry F. Hodges and Zoo Atlanta in the mid-1990s.
creators.why: The gorilla exhibit is an early case of VR used to let people live inside an animal's social world.
creators.role_zh: VR 研究者，佐治亚理工学院 GVU 中心
creators.bio_zh: 佐治亚理工学院研究生研究者，1990 年代中期与 Larry F. Hodges 及亚特兰大动物园共同主导“虚拟现实大猩猩展”。
creators.why_zh: 大猩猩展是早期用 VR 让人进入动物社会世界的案例。

creators.name: Larry F. Hodges
creators.role: VR researcher, Georgia Tech, later Clemson University
creators.bio: Virtual-environments researcher known for VR exposure therapy and presence studies.
creators.why: He co-directed the Virtual Reality Gorilla Exhibit.
creators.role_zh: VR 研究者，佐治亚理工学院，后任职克莱姆森大学
creators.bio_zh: 虚拟环境研究者，以 VR 暴露疗法与临场感研究闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他共同主导了“虚拟现实大猩猩展”。

creators.name: Peter Meijer
creators.role: Engineer, inventor of The vOICe
creators.bio: Dutch engineer at Philips Research who developed The vOICe, a visual-to-auditory sensory-substitution system, from 1991.
creators.why: The vOICe is the longest-running open platform for 'seeing with sound'.
creators.role_zh: 工程师，The vOICe 发明者
creators.bio_zh: 飞利浦研究院的荷兰工程师，1991 年起开发视觉转听觉的感官替代系统 The vOICe。
creators.why_zh: The vOICe 是运行时间最长、开放给所有人的“用声音看”平台。

creators.name: Agnes Hegedüs
creators.role: Media artist
creators.bio: Hungarian-born media artist associated with ZKM Karlsruhe; works include Handsight, Fruit Machine and Things Spoken.
creators.why: Handsight moves the eye into the hand and asks what a body is when its sight organ is detachable.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 匈牙利出生的媒体艺术家，与卡尔斯鲁厄 ZKM 关系密切；作品有《Handsight》《Fruit Machine》《Things Spoken》等。
creators.why_zh: 《Handsight》把眼睛移到手上，追问当视觉器官可以拆下时身体是什么。

creators.name: Alvin Lucier
creators.role: Composer (1931–2021)
creators.bio: Experimental composer of the Sonic Arts Union who made acoustic phenomena the subject of his music (I Am Sitting in a Room, Music for Solo Performer).
creators.why: Vespers asks human performers to navigate by echolocation, like bats.
creators.bio_zh: Sonic Arts Union 的实验作曲家，以声学现象本身为音乐主题（《I Am Sitting in a Room》《Music for Solo Performer》）。
creators.why_zh: 《Vespers》让人类表演者像蝙蝠一样靠回声定位行走。
creators.based_zh: 米德尔顿，康涅狄格州，美国

creators.name: David Dunn
creators.role: Composer and bioacoustic researcher
creators.bio: American composer who records sound worlds of insects and ecosystems, often with custom sensors, and works with scientists on bark-beetle acoustics.
creators.why: He places listeners inside the sound worlds of pond insects and beetles in tree bark.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家与生物声学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 美国作曲家，常用自制传感器录制昆虫与生态系统的声音世界，并与科学家合作研究小蠹虫声学。
creators.why_zh: 他让听者进入池塘昆虫和树皮中甲虫的声音世界。

creators.name: Haus-Rucker-Co
creators.role: Architecture and art group (Laurids Ortner, Günter Zamp Kelp, Klaus Pinter)
creators.bio: Viennese group founded in 1967 whose 'Mind Expanding Program' built pneumatic rooms and perception-altering helmets.
creators.why: Their helmets are 1960s ancestors of headsets that transform how the world looks and sounds.
creators.role_zh: 建筑与艺术小组（Laurids Ortner、Günter Zamp Kelp、Klaus Pinter）
creators.bio_zh: 1967 年成立于维也纳，其“心智扩展计划”制作了充气空间与改变感知的头盔。
creators.why_zh: 他们的头盔是 1960 年代改变视听世界的头显的前身。

creators.name: Mark Thompson
creators.role: Artist and beekeeper
creators.bio: American artist who has worked with honeybees since the 1970s in performances and installations.
creators.why: Live-In Hive put an artist's head inside a working colony for weeks.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与养蜂人
creators.bio_zh: 自 1970 年代起以蜜蜂为材料创作表演与装置的美国艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 《Live-In Hive》让艺术家把头放进一个真实的蜂群里长达数周。

creators.name: Greg Marshall
creators.role: Marine biologist and filmmaker, inventor of Crittercam
creators.bio: Marine biologist who invented the animal-borne Crittercam and developed it at National Geographic from 1986.
creators.why: Crittercam made the animal's own point of view a standard research and broadcast image.
creators.role_zh: 海洋生物学家与电影人，Crittercam 发明者
creators.bio_zh: 海洋生物学家，发明了动物携带式摄像机 Crittercam，1986 年起在美国国家地理学会持续开发。
creators.why_zh: Crittercam 让动物自己的视角成为科研与电视中的常见画面。

creators.name: Lucien Castaing-Taylor
creators.role: Filmmaker and anthropologist, Harvard Sensory Ethnography Lab
creators.bio: Directs the Sensory Ethnography Lab at Harvard; films include Sweetgrass and Leviathan.
creators.why: Leviathan hands the camera to fish, gulls and the sea itself.
creators.role_zh: 电影人与人类学家，哈佛感官民族志实验室
creators.bio_zh: 主持哈佛感官民族志实验室，作品包括《Sweetgrass》《Leviathan》。
creators.why_zh: 《Leviathan》把摄影机交给鱼、海鸥和大海本身。

creators.name: Véréna Paravel
creators.role: Filmmaker and anthropologist, Harvard Sensory Ethnography Lab
creators.bio: French-Swiss artist and anthropologist working in the Sensory Ethnography Lab; co-director of Leviathan, Caniba and De Humani Corporis Fabrica.
creators.why: Her films give up the human eye-level in favour of bodies and machines seen from within.
creators.role_zh: 电影人与人类学家，哈佛感官民族志实验室
creators.bio_zh: 法国—瑞士艺术家与人类学家，感官民族志实验室成员，联合执导《Leviathan》《Caniba》《De Humani Corporis Fabrica》。
creators.why_zh: 她的电影放弃人眼高度，转向从内部看身体与机器。

creators.name: MIT Media Lab Synthetic Characters Group
creators.role: Research group led by Bruce Blumberg (1996–2003)
creators.bio: MIT Media Lab group that built autonomous animal characters with emotion and learning, informed by animal-training research.
creators.why: Its installations let visitors act as or through a chicken, a wolf pup and a sheepdog.
creators.role_zh: 由 Bruce Blumberg 领导的研究组（1996–2003）
creators.bio_zh: 麻省理工媒体实验室研究组，借鉴动物训练研究，制作有情绪与学习能力的自主动物角色。
creators.why_zh: 它的装置让观众以一只鸡、一只小狼和一只牧羊犬的身份行动。

creators.name: Susana Soares
creators.role: Designer, London South Bank University
creators.bio: Portuguese designer and researcher, graduate of the RCA Design Interactions programme, working on biology-driven speculative design.
creators.why: Bee's borrows the honeybee's sense of smell as a diagnostic organ for humans.
creators.role_zh: 设计师，伦敦南岸大学
creators.bio_zh: 葡萄牙设计师与研究者，毕业于皇家艺术学院交互设计专业，从事以生物学驱动的思辨设计。
creators.why_zh: 《Bee's》借用蜜蜂的嗅觉，把它变成人类的诊断器官。

creators.name: Dunne & Raby
creators.role: Critical design practice (Anthony Dunne, Fiona Raby)
creators.bio: Anthony Dunne and Fiona Raby led the RCA Design Interactions programme and defined speculative and critical design.
creators.why: Foragers imagines humans growing new digestive organs modelled on other animals.
creators.role_zh: 批判性设计工作室（Anthony Dunne、Fiona Raby）
creators.bio_zh: Anthony Dunne 与 Fiona Raby 曾主持皇家艺术学院交互设计专业，界定了思辨设计与批判性设计。
creators.why_zh: 《Foragers》设想人类仿照其他动物长出新的消化器官。

creators.name: Carsten Höller
creators.role: Artist, trained as an agricultural entomologist
creators.bio: Belgian-born artist with a doctorate in insect olfaction who builds participatory works that alter perception: slides, goggles, flying machines, mirrored carousels.
creators.why: His devices treat the gallery as a lab where visitors test how far their perception and bodily sense can be changed.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，曾受训为农业昆虫学家
creators.bio_zh: 比利时出生的艺术家，拥有昆虫嗅觉方向的博士学位，创作改变感知的参与式作品：滑梯、倒视眼镜、飞行器、镜面旋转木马等。
creators.why_zh: 他的装置把展厅当作实验室，让观众检验自己的感知和身体感可以被改变到什么程度。

creators.name: Tom Froese
creators.role: Cognitive scientist, Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology
creators.bio: Researcher in enactive cognitive science and artificial life who builds minimal sensory-substitution devices to study perception.
creators.why: The Enactive Torch shows how a single vibrating channel becomes a new way of feeling space.
creators.role_zh: 认知科学家，冲绳科学技术大学院大学
creators.bio_zh: 生成认知科学与人工生命研究者，制作极简的感官替代装置来研究感知。
creators.why_zh: 《Enactive Torch》展示了一条振动通道如何成为感受空间的新方式。

works.title: Menagerie
works.description: A head-mounted virtual environment populated by computer-generated birds, dogs and other creatures that flock, walk and scatter around the visitor as they move.
works.description_zh: 一个头戴式虚拟环境，里面的计算机生成的鸟、狗等动物会随着观众的移动成群飞行、行走或四散。
works.idea_en: A landmark of sharing space with autonomous animals rather than steering them: the visitor becomes one more body the flock reacts to.
works.idea_zh: 一个与自主动物共享空间而不是操控它们的里程碑：观众只是动物群会回应的又一个身体。
works.method: Behavioural flocking and procedural legged-locomotion animation rendered in real time to a tracked stereoscopic display (likely a BOOM or HMD).
works.method_zh: 以行为群集算法与程序化多足运动动画实时渲染，输出到带追踪的立体显示器（可能为 BOOM 或头显）。

works.title: The Bush Soul (#1–#3)
works.description: A series of three installations in which a visitor's 'soul', a pulsing sphere of energy, enters a virtual bush of artificial-life creatures that approach, avoid and respond to it; a force-feedback joystick lets the visitor feel the world.
works.description_zh: 三件系列装置：观众的“灵魂”化作一团跳动的能量球，进入由人工生命生物组成的虚拟灌木丛，生物会靠近、回避并回应它；力反馈摇杆让观众感到这个世界。
works.idea_en: Named after the West African belief in a 'bush soul' that lives inside a wild animal, it frames entering a virtual world as sending part of yourself to live among other creatures.
works.idea_zh: 作品名来自西非关于“灌木之魂”栖居在野生动物体内的信仰，把进入虚拟世界理解为把自己的一部分送去与其他生物同住。
works.method: Custom behaviour engine (later Emergence) where each character carries 'feelings' toward objects that drive its movement, with force-feedback joystick navigation.
works.method_zh: 自制行为引擎（后来的 Emergence），每个角色对物体带有驱动其行动的“情感”，并用力反馈摇杆导航。

works.title: Humphrey II
works.description: A flight simulator at the Ars Electronica Center in which a visitor hangs face-down in a harness and flies over a virtual landscape by moving arms and body, feeling wind, turbulence and impact through force feedback.
works.description_zh: Ars Electronica Center 的飞行模拟器：观众面朝下吊在支架中，用手臂与身体动作飞越虚拟地景，通过力反馈感受风、气流和撞击。
works.idea_en: Flying is made with the whole body instead of a joystick, an early public version of the arms-as-wings posture later used by Birdly.
works.idea_zh: 飞行靠全身而不是摇杆完成，是后来 Birdly 所用“手臂即翅膀”姿态的早期公共版本。
works.method: Body suspended in a motion-controlled harness with pneumatic force feedback, head-mounted display and body tracking; successor to the 1994 Humphrey simulator.
works.method_zh: 身体悬挂在运动控制支架上，配合气动力反馈、头戴显示器与身体追踪；是 1994 年 Humphrey 模拟器的后继。

works.title: Floating Eye
works.description: A camera hangs from a small blimp floating above the participant, who wears a dome-shaped display and walks while seeing only the blimp's wide-angle view, looking down on their own body.
works.description_zh: 一台摄像机挂在参与者头顶上方漂浮的小飞艇上，参与者戴着穹顶形显示器行走，只能看到飞艇的广角画面，从上方俯视自己的身体。
works.idea_en: Vision is handed to a floating machine: you steer your body from a bird's- or drone's-eye position outside it.
works.idea_zh: 视觉交给一台漂浮的机器：你从身体之外、鸟或无人机的位置操控自己的身体。
works.method: Helium blimp tethered to the participant carries a wide-angle camera whose video is shown in a head-worn hemispherical screen.
works.method_zh: 拴在参与者身上的氦气飞艇携带广角摄像机，画面显示在头戴式半球屏上。

works.title: Inter Discommunication Machine
works.description: Two people wear winged headsets with cameras and microphones; each sees and hears only what the other's headset captures, so they must move through space in each other's perception.
works.description_zh: 两人戴着带翅膀、装有摄像头和麦克风的头戴装置；每人只能看到、听到对方装置采集的画面与声音，必须在对方的感知中移动。
works.idea_en: An early swap of perspectives: the self is steered from outside, the ancestor of body-swap and perceptual-crossing works.
works.idea_zh: 一次早期的视角交换：自我被从外部操控，是身体交换与感知交叉作品的前身。
works.method: Two head-mounted displays linked to each other's head-mounted camera and microphone via wireless video transmission, housed in feathered wing costumes.
works.method_zh: 两台头戴显示器通过无线视频互相连接对方的摄像头与麦克风，装在带羽毛的翅膀服装里。

works.title: OpenSky
works.description: An art project to build and fly a one-person jet-powered glider modelled on the bird-shaped Möwe from Hayao Miyazaki's Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind, flown by the artist lying on its back.
works.description_zh: 一个艺术项目：以宫崎骏《风之谷》中鸟形的“Möwe”为原型，制造并驾驶单人喷气滑翔机，艺术家俯卧在机背上飞行。
works.idea_en: Becoming a bird is taken literally: the body lies on a wing and steers by shifting its weight.
works.idea_zh: “成为鸟”被当真：身体伏在机翼上，靠移动重心来操控方向。
works.method: Custom flying-wing glider (M-02, later jet-powered M-02J) developed over a decade with test flights from 2006.
works.method_zh: 自制飞翼式滑翔机（M-02，后为喷气动力的 M-02J），历经十余年开发，2006 年起试飞。

works.title: Videoplace
works.description: Participants see their live silhouettes on a large screen, where they play with graphic creatures such as the small CRITTER that climbs on their outline, and with other people's silhouettes from a remote room.
works.description_zh: 参与者在大屏幕上看到自己的实时剪影，与爬上剪影轮廓的小生物 CRITTER 等图形生物互动，也能与另一房间里他人的剪影互动。
works.idea_en: The body becomes a graphic shape that other beings can climb, touch and respond to, the groundwork for embodied, full-body interaction.
works.idea_zh: 身体变成可以被其他生物攀爬、触碰和回应的图形，是全身具身交互的基础。
works.method: Real-time video silhouette extraction on custom hardware, composited with computer graphics and projected; no goggles or gloves.
works.method_zh: 在自制硬件上实时提取视频剪影，与计算机图形合成并投影；无需眼镜或手套。

works.title: Interactive Plant Growing
works.description: Visitors touch or approach five real potted plants, and each touch makes a different species of virtual plant grow, twist or stop on a projection screen in real time.
works.description_zh: 观众触碰或靠近五株真实盆栽，每一次触碰都会让投影上不同种类的虚拟植物实时生长、扭动或停止。
works.idea_en: The living plant is the interface: human touch is felt by a plant and translated into plant growth.
works.idea_zh: 活植物就是界面：人的触碰先被植物感知，再被转译为植物的生长。
works.method: Electrical potential between the visitor's hand and each plant is measured and drives an algorithmic plant-growth program.
works.method_zh: 测量观众手与每株植物之间的电位差，用来驱动算法化的植物生长程序。

works.title: Trans Plant
works.description: Walking into a half-round room, visitors see their image on screen as grass and trees grow wherever they step; standing still makes plants grow taller, and body size and speed change what grows.
works.description_zh: 观众走进半圆形空间，在屏幕上看到自己的影像，脚步所到之处长出草和树；静止不动时植物长得更高，身体大小和移动速度决定长出的植物。
works.idea_en: The visitor's body becomes a gardener and a garden: stillness, the tempo of plants, is what makes a forest.
works.idea_zh: 观众的身体既是园丁也是花园：静止，也就是植物的节奏，才能长出森林。
works.method: 3D video key extracts the visitor's body and position; a growth algorithm renders plants around it on a large projection.
works.method_zh: 三维视频抠像提取观众的身体与位置，生长算法在大投影上围绕身体生成植物。

works.title: Dialogue with the Knowbotic South
works.description: In a dark room, visitors navigate a cloud of 'knowbots', agents built from live Antarctic research data, while wind and sound driven by Antarctic conditions fill the space.
works.description_zh: 在黑暗的房间里，观众穿行于由南极实时科研数据生成的“知识机器人”云团中，空间里充满由南极气候驱动的风与声音。
works.idea_en: Antarctica is known only through instruments; the work lets a visitor feel a remote environment as data made bodily.
works.idea_zh: 南极只能通过仪器被认识；作品让观众把远方的环境当作可以用身体感知的数据。
works.method: Networked feeds from Antarctic stations and databases drive computer-generated agents, projection, sound and a wind machine; navigation by tracked pointer (details likely varied by venue).
works.method_zh: 来自南极科考站和数据库的网络数据驱动计算机生成的代理、投影、声音与风机；以追踪指针导航（具体配置可能因展出地点而异）。

works.title: PigeonBlog
works.description: Homing pigeons carry small backpacks that measure carbon monoxide and nitrogen oxides as they fly over Southern California and send readings to a live online map.
works.description_zh: 信鸽背着小背包飞过南加州，测量一氧化碳和氮氧化物，并把读数实时发送到在线地图。
works.idea_en: The city's air is sensed at pigeon altitude: the birds become co-researchers and the map shows the world as they breathe it.
works.idea_zh: 在鸽子的飞行高度感知城市空气：鸽子成为共同研究者，地图呈现的是它们呼吸到的世界。
works.method: Custom GPS, gas-sensor and GSM/SMS backpacks built with Cina Hazegh and Kevin Ponto, streaming to a Google Maps interface.
works.method_zh: 与 Cina Hazegh 和 Kevin Ponto 合作制作的 GPS、气体传感器与 GSM 短信背包，数据实时上传到 Google 地图界面。

works.title: Amphibious Architecture
works.description: Floating tubes in New York's East River and Bronx River carry sensors that detect fish and dissolved oxygen below; lights on top change colour when fish swim past, and people can text the fish and get replies.
works.description_zh: 漂浮在纽约东河与布朗克斯河上的管状装置装有传感器，探测水下的鱼和溶解氧；有鱼游过时顶部的灯会变色，人们还可以给鱼发短信并收到回复。
works.idea_en: Makes fish presence visible from the shore, turning a city river into a surface where people and fish can signal to each other.
works.idea_zh: 让岸上的人看见鱼的存在，把城市河流变成人与鱼互相传递信号的界面。
works.method: Sonar fish detectors and water-quality sensors under buoyant tubes, with LED arrays above and an SMS interface.
works.method_zh: 浮管下方装有声呐鱼探仪与水质传感器，上方是 LED 灯阵，并配有短信接口。
shown_at: Toward the Sentient City, Architectural League of New York 2009

works.title: The Virtual Reality Gorilla Exhibit
works.description: At Zoo Atlanta, students in a head-mounted display take the role of an adolescent gorilla inside a virtual gorilla habitat, and the virtual gorillas react to their approach with dominance and submission behaviours.
works.description_zh: 在亚特兰大动物园，学生戴上头显扮演一只青春期大猩猩，进入虚拟大猩猩栖息地，虚拟大猩猩会以支配与顺从行为回应他们的靠近。
works.idea_en: You learn gorilla social rules by being treated as a gorilla, an early VR case of learning through animal embodiment.
works.idea_zh: 通过被当作大猩猩对待来学习大猩猩的社会规则，是早期通过动物具身来学习的 VR 案例。
works.method: SGI-rendered model of the Zoo Atlanta habitat with behaviour-controlled gorilla agents designed with primatologists, shown in a tracked HMD.
works.method_zh: 以 SGI 渲染亚特兰大动物园栖息地模型，大猩猩代理的行为与灵长类学家共同设计，通过带追踪的头显呈现。

works.title: The vOICe
works.description: A sensory-substitution system that turns camera images into soundscapes: each image is scanned left to right, with height heard as pitch and brightness as loudness, so users learn to 'see' with their ears.
works.description_zh: 一种感官替代系统，把摄像头画面转成声音景观：画面从左到右扫描，高度变成音高、亮度变成响度，使用者学会“用耳朵看”。
works.idea_en: Vision is re-routed through hearing; the long-term training of users shows how the brain adopts a new sensory channel.
works.idea_zh: 视觉改由听觉传达；使用者的长期训练显示大脑如何接纳一条新的感官通道。
works.method: Software image-to-sound mapping running on PCs, phones and camera glasses, freely distributed since the 1990s.
works.method_zh: 在电脑、手机和摄像眼镜上运行的图像转声音映射软件，自 1990 年代起免费提供。

paper.title: An experimental system for auditory image representations

works.title: Handsight
works.description: A visitor holds an eyeball-shaped tracker and moves it inside a transparent glass sphere; a projection shows a virtual world 'inside' the sphere from the point of view of the hand-held eye.
works.description_zh: 观众手持一个眼球形状的追踪器，在透明玻璃球中移动；投影显示从这只手中之眼看到的球“内部”虚拟世界。
works.idea_en: The eye moves into the hand: vision becomes something you reach with, like the eyes on an octopus's arms or a snail's stalks.
works.idea_zh: 眼睛移到了手上：视觉成为伸手去够的东西，就像章鱼腕上或蜗牛触角上的眼睛。
works.method: Polhemus-tracked eyeball interface registered to a physical glass sphere, driving real-time graphics on a projection screen.
works.method_zh: 以 Polhemus 追踪的眼球界面与实体玻璃球对位，驱动投影屏上的实时图形。

works.title: Uirapuru
works.description: A telerobotic flying fish hovers above an indoor 'forest'; gallery visitors and web users steer it and see through its camera eyes, while small robotic 'pingbirds' sing according to internet traffic.
works.description_zh: 一条遥控机器人“飞鱼”悬浮在室内“森林”上方；展厅观众和网上用户操控它，并透过它的摄像头眼睛观看，小型机器人“ping 鸟”则按网络流量鸣唱。
works.idea_en: Telepresence puts you inside a mythical Amazonian creature, seeing the forest from the body of a flying fish.
works.idea_zh: 远程临场让你进入一种亚马逊神话生物的身体，从飞鱼的视角看森林。
works.method: Remote-controlled blimp fish with onboard camera streamed to the web and a VRML world; pingbird songs driven by network ping times.
works.method_zh: 装有摄像头的遥控飞艇鱼把画面传到网络和 VRML 世界；ping 鸟的鸣声由网络 ping 延迟驱动。

works.title: The Eighth Day
works.description: Under a Plexiglas dome live glowing GFP plants, amoebae, fish and mice, plus a 'biobot' robot whose movement is driven by an amoeba colony; online visitors control the biobot's camera eye and see the dome from inside.
works.description_zh: 有机玻璃穹顶下生活着发绿光的转基因植物、阿米巴、鱼和小鼠，还有一个由阿米巴群落驱动运动的“生物机器人”；网上观众控制它的摄像头眼睛，从内部观看穹顶。
works.idea_en: You look out through a robot whose body is steered by single-celled organisms, a shared body of human, machine and microbe.
works.idea_zh: 你透过一台由单细胞生物驱动身体的机器人向外看，这是人、机器与微生物共享的身体。
works.method: Biobot's motors respond to amoeba-colony activity sensed inside it; its camera streams to the web, where viewers set the gaze.
works.method_zh: 生物机器人的马达响应其内部感测到的阿米巴群落活动；摄像头画面流向网络，由观众决定视线方向。

works.title: Vespers
works.description: Blindfolded performers walk through a dark space holding handheld click generators and find their way by listening to the echoes; the piece is dedicated to the bats of the family Vespertilionidae.
works.description_zh: 蒙眼的表演者手持咔嗒声发生器穿过黑暗空间，靠聆听回声找到路；作品献给蝙蝠科（Vespertilionidae）的蝙蝠。
works.idea_en: Human echolocation as a concert: the audience hears a room being mapped by clicks, the way a bat hears it.
works.idea_zh: 把人类回声定位变成一场音乐会：观众听见一个房间被咔嗒声测绘出来，像蝙蝠听到的那样。
works.method: Sondols (sonar-dolls), handheld pulse-wave oscillators whose click rate performers vary to read echoes from walls and objects.
works.method_zh: Sondol（声呐玩偶），一种手持脉冲振荡器，表演者改变咔嗒频率，从墙和物体的回声中读取空间。

works.title: The Sound of Light in Trees
works.description: Recordings made inside the trunks of piñon pines in New Mexico, where bark beetles chew, click and signal to each other during a drought-driven outbreak.
works.description_zh: 在新墨西哥州矮松树干内部录制的声音：在干旱引发的虫灾中，小蠹虫在树皮里啃食、咔嗒作响并互相发信号。
works.idea_en: Listening from inside the tree puts you at beetle scale, in the sound world that decides whether a forest lives.
works.idea_zh: 从树干内部聆听，让你处在甲虫的尺度上，身处决定森林存亡的声音世界。
works.method: Custom contact sensors inserted into phloem tissue, recorded and edited with minimal processing; research follow-up with physicist Jim Crutchfield on beetle acoustics.
works.method_zh: 把自制接触式传感器插入韧皮部组织录音，几乎不做处理地剪辑；之后与物理学家 Jim Crutchfield 合作研究甲虫声学。

works.title: Chaos and the Emergent Mind of the Pond
works.description: A composition built from hydrophone recordings of aquatic insects in freshwater ponds, revealing a dense world of clicks, buzzes and rhythms beneath the surface.
works.description_zh: 一首由淡水池塘中水生昆虫的水听器录音构成的作品，揭示水面下由咔嗒、嗡鸣和节奏组成的稠密世界。
works.idea_en: A pond heard from within sounds like a single thinking organism; listening becomes a way of entering insect time.
works.idea_zh: 从内部聆听，池塘听起来像一个会思考的整体生物；聆听成为进入昆虫时间的方式。
works.method: Hydrophone recordings from ponds in North America and Africa, edited into a continuous piece.
works.method_zh: 来自北美和非洲池塘的水听器录音，剪辑成一首连续作品。

works.title: Flyhead (Environment Transformer)
works.description: A green double-bubble helmet whose split prisms break the view into many facets and whose headphones distort surrounding sound, so the wearer perceives the street like an insect.
works.description_zh: 一顶绿色双泡头盔，内部的分光棱镜把视野分成许多小面，耳机扭曲周围的声音，让佩戴者像昆虫一样感知街道。
works.idea_en: A 1960s headset for compound vision: changing the senses changes the relation to the environment, no computer needed.
works.idea_zh: 一件 1960 年代的“复眼”头显：改变感官就改变了与环境的关系，不需要计算机。
works.method: Polyethylene helmet with an eye-level prism array and stereo headphones fitted with acoustic filters.
works.method_zh: 聚乙烯头盔，内置与眼睛齐平的棱镜阵列和装有声学滤波器的立体声耳机。

works.title: Unicorn (Einhorn)
works.description: A woman walks through fields and woods wearing a tall white horn strapped to her head and torso with bandages, balancing the extension with every step.
works.description_zh: 一名女性头上和身上用绷带绑着一只高高的白色长角，在田野和树林中行走，每一步都要平衡这根延伸物。
works.idea_en: A body extension that changes posture and gait until the wearer moves like another creature, an early prosthetic becoming.
works.idea_zh: 一件改变姿态与步态的身体延伸物，直到佩戴者像另一种生物那样移动，是早期的假体式“成为”。
works.method: Wood-and-fabric horn attached with a harness of straps; performed for film.
works.method_zh: 用木头和布料制成的长角，以绑带固定在身上；为影片拍摄而表演。

works.title: Live-In Hive
works.description: The artist put his head through the floor of a glass-walled hive and stayed inside for long periods while a swarm of honeybees built comb around him and flew in and out through a tube.
works.description_zh: 艺术家把头从一个玻璃蜂箱的底部伸进去，长时间停留在里面，一群蜜蜂在他周围筑巢，并通过一根管子进出。
works.idea_en: Immersion before VR: the hive's heat, hum and smell surround the head, and the human becomes a passive member of the colony.
works.idea_zh: VR 之前的沉浸：蜂巢的热度、嗡鸣和气味包围头部，人成为蜂群中一个被动的成员。
works.method: Wooden box with glass and metal walls, a head opening in the base and a wire tube to the outside for foraging bees.
works.method_zh: 木箱配玻璃和金属壁，底部开有伸头的孔，并用金属丝管通向外面供蜜蜂觅食。

works.title: Crittercam
works.description: A camera and data logger attached to sharks, turtles, seals, whales, penguins and lions that records video from the animal's own body as it hunts, dives and socialises.
works.description_zh: 安装在鲨鱼、海龟、海豹、鲸、企鹅和狮子身上的摄像机与数据记录器，从动物自己的身体记录它捕猎、下潜和社交的画面。
works.idea_en: The animal carries the camera: point-of-view footage that many immersive animal works later imitate.
works.idea_zh: 摄像机由动物携带：这种第一视角画面后来被许多沉浸式动物作品模仿。
works.method: Pressure-rated housing with video, depth, temperature and speed sensors, attached by suction cup, harness or clamp and recovered after release.
works.method_zh: 耐压外壳内装摄像、深度、温度和速度传感器，以吸盘、背带或夹具固定，脱落后回收。

works.title: Leviathan
works.description: A documentary shot aboard a fishing trawler off New Bedford with small cameras strapped to fishermen, thrown among dying fish on deck and plunged under the waves with gulls overhead.
works.description_zh: 一部在新贝德福德外海拖网渔船上拍摄的纪录片，小摄像机绑在渔民身上、扔进甲板上垂死的鱼群，或随着海鸥掠过沉入浪下。
works.idea_en: The camera gives up the human viewpoint and drifts between fish, birds, nets and water, a cinema of nonhuman positions.
works.idea_zh: 摄影机放弃人的视角，在鱼、鸟、渔网与海水之间漂移，是一种非人位置的电影。
works.method: GoPro cameras mounted on bodies, poles and nets, with little narrative editing and dense location sound.
works.method_zh: GoPro 摄像机装在身体、杆子和渔网上，几乎不做叙事剪辑，配以稠密的现场声音。

works.title: Swamped!
works.description: A visitor squeezes, waves and tilts an instrumented plush chicken to guide an animated chicken as it protects its eggs from a hungry raccoon in a barnyard.
works.description_zh: 观众挤压、挥动、倾斜一只装有传感器的毛绒鸡，指挥一只动画鸡在农场里保护鸡蛋，不让饥饿的浣熊偷走。
works.idea_en: A 'sympathetic interface': you steer an animal through a toy version of its body, acting as its conscience rather than its puppeteer.
works.idea_zh: 一种“同感界面”：你通过动物身体的玩具版本来引导它，更像它的良心而不是操偶师。
works.method: Plush toy with accelerometers, gyros, squeeze and bend sensors; gestures recognised with HMMs and fed to autonomous behaviour-based characters.
works.method_zh: 毛绒玩具内置加速度计、陀螺仪、挤压和弯曲传感器；用隐马尔可夫模型识别手势，输入自主行为角色。

paper.title: Sympathetic interfaces: using a plush toy to direct synthetic characters

works.title: AlphaWolf
works.description: Three visitors each play a wolf pup in a virtual pack, howling, growling, whining or barking into a microphone to shape how their pup interacts with its packmates and where it stands in the hierarchy.
works.description_zh: 三名观众各扮演虚拟狼群中的一只小狼，对着麦克风嚎叫、低吼、呜咽或吠叫，决定自己的小狼如何与同伴互动、在等级中处于什么位置。
works.idea_en: You join a pack with your voice: becoming wolf means learning a social order through dominance and submission sounds.
works.idea_zh: 用声音加入狼群：成为狼意味着通过支配与顺从的声音学习一种社会秩序。
works.method: Vocal-affect classification of the visitor's sounds drives autonomous wolf agents with learning, emotion and development models.
works.method_zh: 对观众声音进行情感分类，驱动具有学习、情绪和成长模型的自主狼代理。

paper.title: AlphaWolf: Social Learning, Emotion and Development in Autonomous Virtual Agents

works.title: Bee's
works.description: Hand-blown glass objects hold trained honeybees; a person breathes into the glass and the bees fly into a small chamber if they smell the chemical markers of disease.
works.description_zh: 手工吹制的玻璃器皿里装着受过训练的蜜蜂；人对着玻璃呼气，如果蜜蜂嗅到疾病的化学标记，就会飞进一个小腔室。
works.idea_en: The bee's nose becomes a human organ of perception, a diagnostic sense borrowed from another species.
works.idea_zh: 蜜蜂的鼻子成为人的感知器官，一种从其他物种借来的诊断感官。
works.method: Bees conditioned with Pavlovian training to respond to target odours, housed in two-chamber glass vessels.
works.method_zh: 用巴甫洛夫式训练让蜜蜂对目标气味作出反应，放在双腔玻璃容器中。

works.title: Designs for an Overpopulated Planet: Foragers
works.description: Speculative devices, including artificial rumens and bird-like filters, worn by urban foragers who have borrowed digestive systems from other animals to eat what humans cannot.
works.description_zh: 一组思辨装置，包括人造瘤胃和仿鸟类的过滤器，由城市采集者佩戴：他们借用其他动物的消化系统，去吃人类无法消化的东西。
works.idea_en: Becoming animal as survival: the human body is redesigned with organs of cows, birds and rodents.
works.idea_zh: 为了生存而成为动物：用牛、鸟和啮齿动物的器官重新设计人类身体。
works.method: Prototype props and photographs presenting wearable fermentation and filtering devices.
works.method_zh: 以道具原型和照片呈现可穿戴的发酵与过滤装置。

works.title: Flying Machine
works.description: A visitor is strapped face-down into a harness on a motorised arm and swung in wide circles through the gallery, arms free, like a bird gliding over the crowd.
works.description_zh: 观众面朝下被绑在电动悬臂的吊带里，在展厅上空大幅度绕圈飞行，双臂自由，像一只滑翔在人群上方的鸟。
works.idea_en: Flight as a physical sensation rather than an image: the body feels lift, speed and the view down on others, without a headset.
works.idea_zh: 飞行是一种身体感受而不是图像：不戴头显，身体就能感到升力、速度和俯视他人的视野。
works.method: Harness suspended from a rotating steel arm driven by a motor, with the rider's weight and position setting the ride.
works.method_zh: 吊带悬挂在电机驱动的旋转钢臂上，骑乘者的体重和姿势决定飞行状态。

works.title: Upside-Down Goggles
works.description: Visitors put on prism goggles that flip the visual world upside down and try to walk, reach and climb stairs until the body starts to adapt.
works.description_zh: 观众戴上把视觉世界上下颠倒的棱镜眼镜，尝试行走、伸手和上下楼梯，直到身体开始适应。
works.idea_en: Perception is learned and can be relearned: a simple optical swap shows how quickly a body adapts to a new way of seeing, the premise behind any sensory becoming.
works.idea_zh: 感知是习得的，也可以重新习得：一次简单的光学翻转就显示身体多快能适应新的看法，这是所有感官“成为”的前提。
works.method: Prism goggles inverting the image, after George Stratton's 1890s experiments; worn for minutes or, in trials, for days.
works.method_zh: 借鉴 George Stratton 在 1890 年代的实验，用棱镜眼镜翻转画面；可戴几分钟，实验中曾连续佩戴数天。

works.title: Your blind passenger
works.description: A 90-metre tunnel filled with dense coloured fog in which visitors can see only about a metre ahead and move by sound, touch and the shifting colour of the light.
works.description_zh: 一条 90 米长、充满浓密彩色雾气的隧道，观众只能看清前方约一米，靠声音、触觉和光色变化前进。
works.idea_en: Taking sight away makes the other senses lead; the body finds its way the way a burrowing animal might, by nearness and sound.
works.idea_zh: 拿走视觉，让其他感官引路；身体像穴居动物那样，靠距离感和声音找到方向。
works.method: Fog machines and coloured fluorescent lights in a long enclosed corridor, with colour shifting from yellow to blue along the way.
works.method_zh: 在封闭长廊中使用造雾机与彩色荧光灯，沿途光色由黄变蓝。

works.title: The Enactive Torch
works.description: A handheld device that measures the distance to whatever it points at and turns it into vibration on the hand, so blindfolded users sweep it like a whisker to feel objects and gaps.
works.description_zh: 一种手持装置，测量所指物体的距离并转成手上的振动，蒙眼的使用者像挥动胡须一样扫动它，感受物体和空隙。
works.idea_en: One vibrating channel, used actively, becomes a sense of space: perception lives in the loop of moving and sensing, as with a mole's nose or a rat's whiskers.
works.idea_zh: 一条振动通道只要被主动使用，就会成为空间感：感知存在于移动与感受的回路中，就像鼹鼠的鼻子或老鼠的胡须。
works.method: Ultrasonic or infrared range sensor mapped to a vibrotactile motor, with logged sweeps used in perception experiments.
works.method_zh: 超声或红外测距传感器映射到振动马达，记录扫动数据用于感知实验。

paper.title: The Enactive Torch: A New Tool for the Science of Perception

leads.name: Dancing with the Virtual Dervish: Virtual Bodies (Diane Gromala & Yacov Sharir, Banff 1994)
leads.why: Banff Art and Virtual Environments piece where you enter a virtual human body; body-as-landscape, not nonhuman.

leads.name: Archeology of a Mother Tongue (Toni Dove & Michael Mackenzie, Banff 1993)
leads.why: Banff VR work; narrative, no nonhuman embodiment.

leads.name: Inherent Rights, Vision Rights (Lawrence Paul Yuxweluptun, Banff 1992)
leads.why: Banff VR longhouse with spirit beings; check whether animal spirits are embodied.

leads.name: A-Volve (Sommerer & Mignonneau 1994)
leads.why: Golden Nica 1994; visitors draw creatures that live in a water pool, but do not become them.

leads.name: Liquid Views (Monika Fleischmann & Wolfgang Strauss 1992)
leads.why: Narcissus mirror in virtual water; self-image dissolves in ripples, weak water-becoming.

leads.name: Terrain 01 (Ulrike Gabriel 1993)
leads.why: Brainwave-controlled light drives solar robots; control, not embodiment.

leads.name: Bar Code Hotel (Perry Hoberman 1994)
leads.why: Banff/SIGGRAPH VR where barcoded objects act as characters; object-personas, borderline.

leads.name: World Skin (Maurice Benayoun 1997)
leads.why: Golden Nica CAVE work about war photography; not nonhuman.

leads.name: Feral Robotic Dogs (Natalie Jeremijenko 2002)
leads.why: Hacked robot dogs sniff pollutants; robot-senses work, no stable media found.

leads.name: Mussel Choir / OOZ (Natalie Jeremijenko, Environmental Health Clinic)
leads.why: Mussels as water-quality sensors that 'sing'; human-animal interfaces.

leads.name: Zoomorph (Lisa Jevbratt)
leads.why: Software filters showing images as various animals would see them; project page offline.

leads.name: BrainPort / tongue display unit (Paul Bach-y-Rita, 1998–2000s)
leads.why: Electrotactile tongue display successor to TVSS; machine-cyborg holds TVSS only.

leads.name: Duncan the Highland Terrier / Sheep|Dog: Trial by Eire (MIT Synthetic Characters 2000)
leads.why: Voice-directed sheepdog installation; similar to AlphaWolf.

leads.name: Humphrey (Ars Electronica Center 1994)
leads.why: First-generation flight simulator preceding Humphrey II.

leads.name: Finger Gloves (Rebecca Horn 1972)
leads.why: Body extension that lengthens fingers to touch distant surfaces; no stable image found.

leads.name: Teleporting an Unknown State (Eduardo Kac 1996)
leads.why: Web users send light to grow a plant in the dark; collective plant care, not embodiment.
